column5: CSU Fort Collins, injectable confirmed feline oral SCC accessible to repeated anesthesia/injections, local nodes permitted but no distant spread, no immunosuppression or major organ disease. Covered eligible screening and enrolled care, up to $1,000 for adverse events; diagnosis and nonstudy tests remain owner-paid. Exact AVMA cutoff through 2027-12-31 stored separately.

CSU Fort Collins Deanna Worley, giant breed OR ≥40 kg, suspected or confirmed distal-radius OSA, no metastases, able to receive limb-sparing surgery and no drugs affecting immunity. Implant, surgery, chemotherapy and follow-up covered; owners pay initial diagnosis, non-CSU visits and excess complication costs. Official protocol details give the stored complication support. Exact AVMA cutoff through 2027-12-31 stored separately.

David exact anti-PD-L1/IRDye800 with two presurgical doses for confirmed canine oral SCC or oral malignant melanoma, >1 year, healthy for anesthesia; AVMA clinical details confirm immune/drug exclusions. Owner pays initial screening, workup and treatment beyond $1,500 incentive; preoperative biopsy and additional hospitalization covered. Davis VCCT. Retain modern native institutional cutoff 2028-06-30, not AVMA display 2028-06-29.

Penn Philadelphia existing exact cathepsin-activated NIR guidance for oral SCC surgery. Confirmed surgically eligible dogs; no prior or current surgery, chemo or RT for this cancer and no immediate competing threat. $3,000 toward surgery, remaining costs not promised. VCIC 215-573-0302. Distinct from UC Davis anti-PD-L1/IRDye800.

Madrid Puchol site recruiting since 2026-09-01, dog ≥7 kg with presumed high grade MRI glioma, individual referral evaluation. Six 21-day cycles with IV in clinic and oral treatment at home. Protocol treatment, MRI follow-up and study labs financed by TRANSCAN-3; initial/outside costs not stated. Formal AEMPS authorisation stated, no dated enrollment closure in this primary.

Dallas VROC dog presumed MRI/confirmed glioma, primary or recurrent after surgery, prednisone possible, prior tumour RT forbidden and two week chemotherapy washout; no concurrent immunotherapy and must stop antioxidants. RT regimen selected by team, with randomized CAR-neutrophil/no CAR arm. Study subsidized, off-study diagnostics/palliative care owner paid. Paige Neumann. Existing cutoff June 1 2029.

Dallas VROC dog MRI-presumed or confirmed glioma, primary or recurrent, able to receive prednisone, no previous tumour RT and no concurrent chemo/immunotherapy, two week chemo washout and stop antioxidants. Repeated ferumoxytol plus fractionated stereotactic RT. Study may be partly or fully subsidized, off-study costs may be owner-paid. Paige Neumann. Existing cutoff June 1 2027.

Dallas dog confirmed active accessible melanoma, no prior chemotherapy or major anesthetic-risk illness, master handout age >6 months. Separate IV/IT carboplatin arms with/without HIFU; owners pay all listed costs unless individual subsidy stated. Paige Neumann, VROC. Current official oncology roster names this protocol separately.
